'''Carlos Espí Escrihuela''' (born 24 July 2005) is a Spanish professional [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[striker (association football)|striker]] for {{Spanish football updater|Real Madrid}} club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]].

Espí developed through the youth system of [[Levante UD|Levante]] and made his first-team debut in 2024. After establishing himself with the senior side and being named La Liga's best under-23 player, he joined Real Madrid in 2026.

Espí has represented Spain at [[Spain national under-19 football team|under-19]], [[Spain national under-20 football team|under-20]] and [[Spain national under-21 football team|under-21]] level.

==Club career==
===Early career===
Born in [[Tavernes de la Valldigna]], Valencian Community, Espí began his career with hometown side [[CF UE Tavernes de la Valldigna|Tavernes]] at the age of six.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ondanaranjacope.com/noticias/orgullo-ue-tavernes-carlos-espi-un-ejemplo-de-constancia-y-disciplina-en-el-futbol|title=Orgullo UE Tavernes: Carlos Espi, un ejemplo de constancia y disciplina en el fútbol|trans-title=Pride of UE Tavernes: Carlos Espi, and example of consistency and discipline in football|publisher=Onda Naranja [[Cadena COPE|COPE]]|language=es|date=13 December 2024|accessdate=7 August 2026}}</ref> In 2020, he joined [[UD Alzira|Alzira]], where he spent two seasons playing mainly for their ''Cadete'' and ''Juvenil'' squads.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.levante-emv.com/safor/2026/05/13/tavernes-valldigna-presume-mundialista-carlos-130177247.html|title=Tavernes de la Valldigna presume de su "mundialista" Carlos Espí y le da su nombre al Campus de Fútbol de Verano 2026|trans-title=Tavernes de la Valldigna proudly highlights its "World Cup" player Carlos Espí and names its 2026 Summer Football Camp after him|publisher=[[Levante-EMV]]|language=es|date=13 May 2026|accessdate=7 August 2026}}</ref> In that club, he also made his senior debut with the B-team, playing the last 19 minutes of a 1–0 [[Segunda Regional de la Comunidad Valenciana|Segunda Regional Valenciana]] home win over Barxeta.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ffcv.es/competiciones/partidos/partido.php?cod_partido=8887423|title=U.D. Alzira 'B' 1–0 U.E. Barxeta 'A'|publisher=[[Valencian Community Football Federation]]|language=es|accessdate=7 August 2026}}</ref>

===Levante===
Espí joined [[Levante UD|Levante]]'s youth setup in 2022, initially for the ''Juvenil'' team.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://plazadeportiva.valenciaplaza.com/el-delantero-espi-de-18-anos-se-estrena-en-una-convocatoria-del-levante|title=El delantero Espí, de 18 años, se estrena en una convocatoria del Levante|trans-title=Forward Espí, aged 18, debuts in a Levante call up|publisher=Plaza Deportiva|work=Valencia Plaza|language=es|date=9 February 2024|accessdate=22 February 2024}}</ref> He made his debut with [[Atlético Levante UD|the reserves]] on 19 November 2023, coming on as a late [[Substitute (association football)|substitute]] in a 0–0 [[Tercera Federación]] home draw against [[UD Rayo Ibense|Rayo Ibense]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.levanteud.com/noticias/el-atletico-levante-ud-obtiene-poco-premio-0-0-frente-a-un-buen-ud-rayo-ibense|title=El Atlético Levante UD obtiene poco premio (0–0) frente a un buen UD Rayo Ibense|trans-title=Atlético Levante UD get little rewardspremio (0–0) against a good UD Rayo Ibense|publisher=Levante UD|language=es|date=19 November 2023|accessdate=22 February 2024}}</ref>

Espí scored his first senior goal on 29 November 2023, netting the B's opener in a 2–1 home success over [[Silla CF|Silla]]; it was also his first senior start.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://valenciabase.com/carlos-espi-primera-titularidad-con-el-at-levante-y-primer-gol/|title=Carlos Espí, primera titularidad con el At Levante y primer gol|trans-title=Carlos Espí, first start with At. Levante and first goal|publisher=Valencia Base|language=pt-BR|date=1 December 2023|accessdate=22 February 2024}}</ref> He made his first team debut the following 18 February, replacing [[Mohamed Bouldini]] late into a 0–0 [[Segunda División]] away draw against [[Racing de Ferrol]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/segunda-division/cronica/2024/02/18/65d230dfe2704eae978b4577.html|title=El Racing aguanta más de una hora con uno menos ante un Levante romo|trans-title=Racing hold down for more than an hour with a man down against a dull Levante|publisher=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|language=es|date=18 February 2024|accessdate=22 February 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://valenciabase.com/debut-de-carlos-espi-con-el-primer-equipo-del-levante-ud/|title=Debut de Carlos Espí con el primer equipo del Levante UD|trans-title=Debut of Carlos Espí with the first team of Levante UD|publisher=Valencia Base|language=es|date=18 February 2024|accessdate=22 February 2024}}</ref>

Espí scored his first professional goal on 26 May 2024, netting his team's second in a 2–2 home draw against [[AD Alcorcón|Alcorcón]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.levanteud.com/en/news/carlos-espi-it-was-a-very-special-day-for-me-and-all-my-people|title=Carlos Espí: "It Was a Very Special Day for Me and All My People"|publisher=Levante UD|date=27 May 2024|accessdate=12 May 2026}}</ref> He was regularly used in the main squad during the [[2024–25 Segunda División|2024–25 season]], scoring six times as the club returned to [[La Liga]] after three years.

Espí made his debut in the main category of Spanish football on 23 August 2025, playing the last 15 minutes in a 3–2 home loss to [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]. He scored his first goal in the division the following 4 January, netting his team's second in a 3–0 win at [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.diariodesevilla.es/sevillafc/carlos-espi-gran-amenaza-sevilla_0_2006561246.html|title=Carlos Espí, la gran amenaza del Sevilla: 10 puntos para el Levante en las últimas seis jornadas|trans-title=Carlos Espí, Sevilla's greatest threat: 10 points for Levante in the last six rounds|publisher=[[Diario de Sevilla]]|language=es|date=22 April 2026|accessdate=12 May 2026}}</ref>

On 24 February 2026, Espí renewed his link with the ''Granotes'' until 2028,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.levanteud.com/en/news/carlos-espi-renueva-su-compromiso-con-el-levante-ud|title=Carlos Espí renews his commitment to Levante UD|publisher=Levante UD|date=24 February 2026|accessdate=12 May 2026}}</ref> and scored a brace in a 2–0 home success over [[Deportivo Alavés|Alavés]] three days later.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.levanteud.com/en/news/carlos-espi-refuerza-la-fe-granota|title=Carlos Espí strengthens the Levante faith|publisher=Levante UD|date=27 February 2026|accessdate=12 May 2026}}</ref> He scored five goals in the following five matches, including another double in a 4–2 win over [[Real Oviedo]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/primera/carlos-espi-resucita-al-levante-f202604-n/|title=Carlos Espí resucita al Levante|trans-title=Carlos Espí revives Levante|publisher=[[Diario AS]]|language=es|date=13 April 2026|accessdate=12 May 2026}}</ref> He concluded the 2025–26 season as his club's top scorer with 11 goals.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.laliga.com/en-GB/news/carlos-espi-laliga-ea-sports-2025-2026-u-23-player-of-the-year |title=Carlos Espí, LALIGA EA SPORTS 2025/2026 U-23 Player of the Year |publisher=La Liga |date=4 June 2026 }}</ref>

===Real Madrid===
On 30 July 2026, Espí signed for La Liga club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] on a contract until 30 June 2031, becoming the biggest sale in Levante's history in a deal reportedly worth a €25 million release clause.<ref>{{Cite web |date=30 July 2026 |title=Official Announcement: Carlos Espí |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/club/announcements/comunicado-oficial-carlos-espi-30-07-2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260730203633/https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/club/announcements/comunicado-oficial-carlos-espi-30-07-2026 |archive-date=30 July 2026 |access-date=30 July 2026 |publisher=[[Real Madrid CF]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release|title=Levante UD and Real Madrid agree on the transfer of Carlos Espí|url=https://www.levanteud.com/en/news/el-levante-ud-y-el-real-madrid-acuerdan-el-traspaso-de-carlos-espi|publisher=Levante UD|date=30 July 2026|access-date=30 July 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Cortegana|first=Mario|title=Real Madrid agree deal to sign Levante striker Carlos Espí|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7481174/2026/07/30/carlos-espi-real-madrid-transfer/|publisher=[[The Athletic]]|date=30 July 2026|access-date=30 July 2026}}</ref> A month later, on 22 August, he scored his first goal on his debut, securing a 2–1 away victory over [[RCD Espanyol|Espanyol]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/football/first-team/reports/cronica-espanyol-real-madrid-j2-liga-22-08-2026 |title=Victory against Espanyol in the opening league match |publisher=Real Madrid CF |date=22 August 2026 }}</ref> On 14 October, he scored his first [[UEFA Champions League]] goal, equalising the score at 3–3 as Madrid came from 1–3 down to defeat [[AS Roma|Roma]] 4–3 away from home.<ref>{{cite web|last=Emmons|first=Michael|title=Roma 3–4 Real Madrid: Los Blancos win after stunning late fightback|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmwyqp5q1lypt|publisher=BBC Sport|date=14 October 2026|access-date=14 October 2026|archive-date=14 October 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20261014222637/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmwyqp5q1lypt|url-status=live}}</ref>

==International career==
On 13 February 2024, Espí was called up to the [[Spain national under-19 football team|Spain national under-19 team]] for two friendlies against [[Norway national under-19 football team|Norway]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.levanteud.com/en/news/carlos-espi-and-alvaro-moreno-make-their-debut-in-the-spanish-u-19-national-team-call-up|title=Carlos Espí and Álvaro Moreno Make Their Debut in the Spanish U-19 National Team Call-Up|publisher=Levante UD|date=13 February 2024|accessdate=22 February 2024}}</ref> He featured in both matches, scoring twice in the first one.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.levanteud.com/noticias/buen-debut-de-carlos-espi-y-alvaro-moreno-con-la-seleccion-espanola-sub-19|title=Buen debut de Carlos Espí y Álvaro Moreno con la Selección española Sub-19|trans-title=Good debut of Carlos Espí and Álvaro Moreno with the Spain national under-19 team|publisher=Levante UD|language=es|date=22 February 2024|accessdate=22 February 2024}}</ref>
